usedFor: Calendly is where people book time with you; HubSpot keeps the contact record. Each booking or cancellation in Calendly can write to HubSpot through “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Whoever books gets into the CRM, or is updated if they exist, matched by email, so you never double-enter.

watchOut: “Create or Update Contact” matches on email. “Invitee Canceled” also fires it, so a cancel and a booking from the same person both touch the same contact.
